facts.business: Fusion Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) focused on microfinance and MSME financing, providing income-generating loans, loan against property, working capital, and business expansion funding to self-employed borrowers, while also distributing insurance products.

guidance_or_targets.statement: In MFI, we will accelerate calibrated volume growth through improved origination infrastructure

key_risks: Regulatory and compliance changes relating to lending practices, provisioning norms, customer protection, governance standards, and data privacy
RBI's emphasis on responsible lending and borrower-level exposure norms
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
